narrative.overview:
Prism Local follows the owner's confirmed 简约风 direction and familiar Prism-style main page and editor. Its established visual character is quiet, compact and practical: neutral writing surfaces, fine separators, small line icons and clear actions leave the document at the center. This records the incumbent world; it does not establish a replacement identity.

The file-manager extension carries that character into upload, move, Trash and restore review. A centered dialog presents context, destination or affected paths, then a named action. Writing checks extends the same tool vocabulary with bundled English (US/UK) spelling, independent LaTeX hints and personal words: active-file context precedes inspectable findings and explicit corrections. Saved chats continue it through named conversation rows, a bounded reading area and compact source/review controls. Existing-table drafts extend the same vocabulary through a schematic source grid, native structure controls and review before one reversible Apply. Clipboard choices reuse that vocabulary through a captured target, native format choices, bounded content/source inspection and a reachable paste/recovery footer. Local comments continue it through the Review sidebar, original source quotes, rule-separated plain-text messages and reachable thread/reply controls. Local-first editing is the current product context; this document does not define the appearance of future hosted collaboration.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral dark and light themes with inverted primary actions.
Compact toolbars and file navigation; more breathing room inside review dialogs.
Native inputs, selects, checkboxes and dialogs with visible keyboard focus.
Lucide line icons paired with labels, paths or accessible names.
Reviewable path lists, explicit operation states and recoverable file changes.
Local writing controls, source-context findings and explicit reversible corrections.
Named saved chats, compact reply metadata and readable local Markdown/math within the existing editor.
Source-preserving table drafts with truthful cell selection, bounded source review and explicit recovery controls.
Immediate supported formatted paste with isolated Undo, and explicit clipboard review when content requires choices.
Local source-anchored discussion with truthful passage status, retained drafts and explicit saved-versus-draft recovery.

rules.name: The Neutral Actions Rule
rules.body: Keep primary operations neutral and inverted; use semantic color to explain state rather than recolor the entire review surface.

rules.name: The Review Before Apply Rule
rules.body: Put affected paths and the operation's current status before the final action; gate that action while a valid review is unavailable or an operation is running.

rules.name: The Explicit Correction Rule
rules.body: Keep the active-file context, finding and source excerpt ahead of a named correction; apply a source change only after the author chooses it, and keep it reversible through the editor's normal Undo.

rules.name: The Reachable History Rule
rules.body: Keep conversation identity and chronological paging outside the scrolling reply region, with the existing composer reachable below it; contain long code, math and tables within the reply.

rules.name: The Source-preserving Draft Rule
rules.body: Keep table source and document history unchanged while the author selects, edits and reviews a local draft; show truthful logical selection, complete-source recovery and one explicit reversible Apply.

rules.name: The Reversible Clipboard Rule
rules.body: Paste ordinary supported content as one reversible edit; require review when source recovery, packages or detected losses need a choice, keeping the captured target, complete source and recovery action inspectable before insertion.

rules.name: The Reviewed Image Rule
rules.body: Review destination and replacement consent before saving a clipboard image, then insert its figure explicitly; keep upload recovery separate from document Undo.

rules.name: The Anchored Discussion Rule
rules.body: Keep original source context and changed/removed status truthful, preserve local wording across navigation or conflicts, and require an explicit retarget or saved-thread rebase before a stale draft is posted.

rules.name: The Reachable Thread Rule
rules.body: Keep thread return navigation and the end-of-thread reply reachable within the scrolling Review sidebar; retain read-only inspection and accessible source navigation while mutations are locked.
